title: 豐寧抽蓄水電站
summary: 豐寧抽蓄電站裝有 12 台 300 MW 機組，其中 2 台為交流勵磁變速機組，是目前世界上裝置容量最大的抽蓄電站；課程定量分析 425 m 水頭的機組與約 40 GWh 的蓄能量、一次建成十二台機組的超長地下廠房，以及與張北柔性直流電網配合消納風電和光電。
summaryEn: Fengning has twelve 300 MW units, two of them AC-excited variable-speed machines, and is the largest pumped-storage station by capacity in the world; the course quantifies units at 425 m head and about 40 GWh of storage, the very long underground powerhouse for twelve units, and operation with the Zhangbei VSC-HVDC grid to absorb wind and solar.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 世界最大的 3,600 MW 抽蓄電站與柔性直流電網的配合
v30FocusEn: The world's largest pumped-storage station at 3,600 MW and its pairing with a VSC-HVDC grid

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：豐寧抽蓄水電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上池蓄能量」與「配合風光基地的調節任務」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Balancing a wind and solar base": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" is correct?
options: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。
抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。
只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。
optionsEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head.
Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more.
With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed.
quiz.explanation: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「上池蓄能量」如何決定「豐寧抽蓄水電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。與電池不同，功率（由機組與水道決定）和能量（由水庫容積決定）可以分開設計，因此同樣的機組可以搭配數小時到數十小時的蓄能。上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：12 台可逆式機組各 300 MW，總裝置容量 3,600 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: Twelve reversible units of 300 MW give 3,600 MW
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「上池蓄能量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Energy stored in the upper reservoir”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir
knowledge.text: 抽蓄電站把電能轉成上池水體的位能：可用蓄能量與上池有效容積及平均水頭成正比。與電池不同，功率（由機組與水道決定）和能量（由水庫容積決定）可以分開設計，因此同樣的機組可以搭配數小時到數十小時的蓄能。上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。
knowledge.textEn: A pumped-storage plant turns electricity into potential energy of water in the upper reservoir: usable energy is proportional to live volume and mean head. Unlike a battery, power, set by the units and waterways, and energy, set by reservoir volume, can be designed separately, so the same units can be paired with a few hours to tens of hours of storage. As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 12 台可逆式機組各 300 MW，總裝置容量 3,600 MW
knowledge.textEn: Twelve reversible units of 300 MW give 3,600 MW

quiz.question: 依「上池蓄能量」的模型 E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²，上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹² for "Energy stored in the upper reservoir", which value is closest to the energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)?
options: 20.8 GWh
41.7 GWh
417 GWh
optionsEn: 20.8 GWh
41.7 GWh
417 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 40 hm³、H = 425 m、η = 0.9，得 41.7 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 40 hm³, H = 425 m, η = 0.9 the result is 41.7 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上池蓄能量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 40 hm³、H = 425 m、η = 0.9，得 41.7 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Vu 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 40 hm³, H = 425 m, η = 0.9 the result is 41.7 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Vu by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 45.9 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 45.9 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 41.7 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Vu 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 41.7 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Vu with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Vu = 40 hm³、H = 425 m、η = 0.9，得 41.7 GWh（上池有效容積（1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³）全部放水可發出的電量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = ρ·g·V·H·η / 3.6×10¹²; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Vu = 40 hm³, H = 425 m, η = 0.9 the result is 41.7 GWh (energy generated by releasing the full live volume (1 hm³ = 10⁶ m³)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Vu 增加 10% 時，結果變為 45.9 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Vu by 10% changes the result to 45.9 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上池蓄能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy stored in the upper reservoir"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
岩石很堅硬，地下洞室挖好後不需要支撐也不會變形。
以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Rock is hard, so an underground cavern needs no support and does not deform once excavated.

Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.
quiz.explanation: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上池蓄能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水庫水位—容積曲線與機組流量計，在一次完整的發電循環中積分流量與出力，核對實測蓄能量；並比對水位計、流量與電表三者的質量與能量平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Using the level-volume curve and unit flow meters, integrate discharge and output over one complete generating cycle to check measured stored energy, and reconcile mass and energy balances among level gauges, flow and revenue meters.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要分別寫明額定功率、可用蓄能量與對應的水位範圍，並註明效率與水頭的計算基準。
knowledge.textEn: Specifications should state rated power, usable energy and the corresponding level range separately, with the efficiency and head basis.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「上池蓄能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。
optionsEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed.
quiz.explanation: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 上池蓄能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy stored in the upper reservoir: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上池蓄能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Energy stored in the upper reservoir” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「豐寧抽蓄水電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上池水位變動時水頭跟著改變，機組必須在整個水頭變幅內都能穩定發電與抽水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: As the upper level changes so does the head, and the units must generate and pump stably across the whole head range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽蓄電站的蓄能量由機組容量決定，機組越大蓄得越多。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storage energy of a pumped plant is set by unit capacity; bigger units store more." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把總庫容當成有效容積，或忽略低水位時水頭與效率下降，宣稱的蓄能時數會偏高；實際調度到循環末段時機組提前因最低水頭限制而停機。
knowledge.textEn: Treating gross volume as live volume, or ignoring lower head and efficiency at low level, overstates storage hours; in practice units stop early near the end of the cycle on minimum-head limits.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「配合風光基地的調節任務」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Balancing a wind and solar base" is correct?
options: 只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
豐寧位於河北北部的風電與光電基地旁，並接入張北柔性直流電網。
optionsEn: With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Fengning sits beside the wind and solar bases of northern Hebei and connects to the Zhangbei VSC-HVDC grid.
quiz.explanation: 豐寧位於河北北部的風電與光電基地旁，並接入張北柔性直流電網。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fengning sits beside the wind and solar bases of northern Hebei and connects to the Zhangbei VSC-HVDC grid. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 配合風光基地的調節任務：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Balancing a wind and solar base: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「配合風光基地的調節任務」如何決定「豐寧抽蓄水電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Balancing a wind and solar base” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 豐寧位於河北北部的風電與光電基地旁，並接入張北柔性直流電網。風力與太陽能的出力隨天氣在數分鐘到數日的尺度上變動：電站在風大日照強時抽水吸收多餘電力，在無風的夜晚發電，並隨時準備在出力驟變時補位。它一次蓄滿可儲存約 40 GWh，相當於數百萬千瓦的風電場數小時的發電量，使送往北京的電力曲線比風光本身平滑得多。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fengning sits beside the wind and solar bases of northern Hebei and connects to the Zhangbei VSC-HVDC grid. Wind and solar output varies with weather over minutes to days: the station pumps when wind and sun are strong, generates on calm nights, and stands ready to fill in when output changes suddenly. A full charge of about 40 GWh equals hours of generation from several gigawatts of wind farms, making the power sent to Beijing far smoother than the wind and solar themselves. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：額定水頭約 425 m，機組轉速 428.6 rpm
steps.observationEn: Project file: Rated head is about 425 m and unit speed 428.6 rpm
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「配合風光基地的調節任務」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Balancing a wind and solar base”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Fengning sits beside the wind and solar bases of northern Hebei and connects to the Zhangbei VSC-HVDC grid. Wind and solar output varies with weather over minutes to days: the station pumps when wind and sun are strong, generates on calm nights, and stands ready to fill in when output changes suddenly. A full charge of about 40 GWh equals hours of generation from several gigawatts of wind farms, making the power sent to Beijing far smoother than the wind and solar themselves.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「配合風光基地的調節任務」的模型 t = E / P，以 40 GWh 蓄能量吸收 3,000 MW 風電過剩出力可持續的時間最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = E / P for "Balancing a wind and solar base", which value is closest to the hours for which 40 GWh of storage can absorb 3,000 MW of surplus wind?
quiz.explanation: t = E / P；代入 E = 40 GWh、P = 3000 MW，得 13.3 h（以 40 GWh 蓄能量吸收 3,000 MW 風電過剩出力可持續的時間）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = E / P; with E = 40 GWh, P = 3000 MW the result is 13.3 h (hours for which 40 GWh of storage can absorb 3,000 MW of surplus wind). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 配合風光基地的調節任務：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Balancing a wind and solar base: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「配合風光基地的調節任務」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Balancing a wind and solar base” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = E / P；代入 E = 40 GWh、P = 3000 MW，得 13.3 h（以 40 GWh 蓄能量吸收 3,000 MW 風電過剩出力可持續的時間）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 P 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = E / P; with E = 40 GWh, P = 3000 MW the result is 13.3 h (hours for which 40 GWh of storage can absorb 3,000 MW of surplus wind). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise P by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：P 增加 10% 時，結果變為 12.1 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising P by 10% changes the result to 12.1 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 13.3 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 P 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 13.3 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in P with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = E / P；代入 E = 40 GWh、P = 3000 MW，得 13.3 h（以 40 GWh 蓄能量吸收 3,000 MW 風電過剩出力可持續的時間）。
knowledge.textEn: t = E / P; with E = 40 GWh, P = 3000 MW the result is 13.3 h (hours for which 40 GWh of storage can absorb 3,000 MW of surplus wind).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: P 增加 10% 時，結果變為 12.1 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising P by 10% changes the result to 12.1 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「配合風光基地的調節任務」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Balancing a wind and solar base"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較電站投產前後同一風光基地的棄風棄光率與送出功率的波動幅度，並統計電站每日的模式切換次數與利用小時。
變速機組的優點只是發電效率高一點。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Compare curtailment and fluctuation of exported power from the same wind and solar base before and after the station entered service, and count daily mode changes and utilisation hours.
The only advantage of a variable-speed unit is slightly higher generating efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 比較電站投產前後同一風光基地的棄風棄光率與送出功率的波動幅度，並統計電站每日的模式切換次數與利用小時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare curtailment and fluctuation of exported power from the same wind and solar base before and after the station entered service, and count daily mode changes and utilisation hours. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 配合風光基地的調節任務：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Balancing a wind and solar base: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配合風光基地的調節任務」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Balancing a wind and solar base” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較電站投產前後同一風光基地的棄風棄光率與送出功率的波動幅度，並統計電站每日的模式切換次數與利用小時。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare curtailment and fluctuation of exported power from the same wind and solar base before and after the station entered service, and count daily mode changes and utilisation hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調度要以數日的風光預測滾動規劃上池水位，預留足夠的抽水與發電空間因應預測誤差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Dispatch should plan upper-reservoir level on a rolling basis from multi-day wind and solar forecasts, keeping room to pump and to generate against forecast error.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連續多日大風而負載偏低時，上池在第一天就被抽滿，之後無法再吸收多餘電力；因此抽蓄只能解決日內到數日的平衡問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With strong wind for several days and low demand the upper reservoir is full after the first day and can absorb no more, so pumped storage solves only balancing within a day to a few days. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較電站投產前後同一風光基地的棄風棄光率與送出功率的波動幅度，並統計電站每日的模式切換次數與利用小時。
knowledge.textEn: Compare curtailment and fluctuation of exported power from the same wind and solar base before and after the station entered service, and count daily mode changes and utilisation hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調度要以數日的風光預測滾動規劃上池水位，預留足夠的抽水與發電空間因應預測誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Dispatch should plan upper-reservoir level on a rolling basis from multi-day wind and solar forecasts, keeping room to pump and to generate against forecast error.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60041 水力機械現場驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60041 Field acceptance tests to determine the hydraulic performance of hydraulic machines. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「配合風光基地的調節任務」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Balancing a wind and solar base" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
連續多日大風而負載偏低時，上池在第一天就被抽滿，之後無法再吸收多餘電力；因此抽蓄只能解決日內到數日的平衡問題。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
With strong wind for several days and low demand the upper reservoir is full after the first day and can absorb no more, so pumped storage solves only balancing within a day to a few days.
quiz.explanation: 連續多日大風而負載偏低時，上池在第一天就被抽滿，之後無法再吸收多餘電力；因此抽蓄只能解決日內到數日的平衡問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With strong wind for several days and low demand the upper reservoir is full after the first day and can absorb no more, so pumped storage solves only balancing within a day to a few days. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 配合風光基地的調節任務：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Balancing a wind and solar base: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「配合風光基地的調節任務」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Balancing a wind and solar base” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連續多日大風而負載偏低時，上池在第一天就被抽滿，之後無法再吸收多餘電力；因此抽蓄只能解決日內到數日的平衡問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「豐寧抽蓄水電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: With strong wind for several days and low demand the upper reservoir is full after the first day and can absorb no more, so pumped storage solves only balancing within a day to a few days. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：它一次蓄滿可儲存約 40 GWh，相當於數百萬千瓦的風電場數小時的發電量，使送往北京的電力曲線比風光本身平滑得多。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A full charge of about 40 GWh equals hours of generation from several gigawatts of wind farms, making the power sent to Beijing far smoother than the wind and solar themselves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有抽蓄電站，風電與光電就完全不會被棄用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a pumped-storage station, no wind or solar power is ever curtailed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 連續多日大風而負載偏低時，上池在第一天就被抽滿，之後無法再吸收多餘電力；因此抽蓄只能解決日內到數日的平衡問題。
knowledge.textEn: With strong wind for several days and low demand the upper reservoir is full after the first day and can absorb no more, so pumped storage solves only balancing within a day to a few days.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
